lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Guided practice: home upkeep and knowing when to call a professional

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic home upkeep and knowing when to call a professional task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: Given twelve provided generic maintenance scenarios (not tied to the learner's real home), the learner sorts each into one of three columns and explains the deciding factor for the two scenarios they found trickiest to sort.
safetyNotes: This task uses a provided generic list of scenarios, not an inspection of the learner's actual home, and requires no real hazard exposure.
Anything resembling fire, gas smell, electrical hazard, or a structural concern always sorts into 'stop and get adult help immediately,' with no exception.

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l03-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l03-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l03-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l03-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: Is there a type of task you sorted as 'handle it myself' that you're actually not fully confident about? What would you want to learn before doing it for real?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l03-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l03-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g12-u02-l03-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Hazard sorting (non-negotiable): All hazard scenarios are correctly sorted into 'stop and get adult help immediately.' | Judgment reasoning: The explanation names a specific deciding factor for each trickiest scenario. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l03-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner write one additional scenario of their own invention for each of the three columns, explaining why each belongs where they placed it.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic home upkeep and knowing when to call a professional task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.sessionPattern: 8–10 minutes model and planning, 8–10 minutes guided try, 20–30 minutes application, 7–10 minutes evidence and revision
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: home upkeep and knowing when to call a professional worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: Given twelve provided generic maintenance scenarios (not tied to the learner's real home), the learner sorts each into one of three columns and explains the deciding factor for the two scenarios they found trickiest to sort.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact home upkeep and knowing when to call a professional decision or action.
Model move 2: Before sorting, name what makes a maintenance issue urgent versus routine to you.
Model move 3: Sort all twelve provided scenarios into the three columns.

Model check: Hazard sorting (non-negotiable): All hazard scenarios are correctly sorted into 'stop and get adult help immediately.' | Judgment reasoning: The explanation names a specific deciding factor for each trickiest scenario.

resources.title: home upkeep and knowing when to call a professional action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal, constraints, and privacy boundary for home upkeep and knowing when to call a professional.
2. Analyze the worked model and identify why its sequence meets the criteria.
3. Complete the guided case and use feedback before moving on.
4. Select the permitted real-life route or the complete fictional route.
5. Carry out the task, retaining only the minimum evidence named in the record.
6. Compare the result with the success checks and complete the correction loop when needed.

resources.title: home upkeep and knowing when to call a professional coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: Given twelve provided generic maintenance scenarios (not tied to the learner's real home), the learner sorts each into one of three columns and explains the deciding factor for the two scenarios they found trickiest to sort.
Coach direction: Before sorting, name what makes a maintenance issue urgent versus routine to you.
Learner prompt: In your own words, what's the difference between a household issue that can wait and one that can't?
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: home upkeep and knowing when to call a professional complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Sort all twelve provided scenarios into the three columns.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I sorted all twelve scenarios into one of the three columns.
Response 2 (t2-p2): Every scenario involving fire, gas smell, electrical hazard, or structural concern is in the 'stop and get adult help immediately' column.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: home upkeep and knowing when to call a professional minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Is there a type of task you sorted as 'handle it myself' that you're actually not fully confident about? What would you want to learn before doing it for real?

Success checks: Hazard sorting (non-negotiable): All hazard scenarios are correctly sorted into 'stop and get adult help immediately.' | Judgment reasoning: The explanation names a specific deciding factor for each trickiest scenario.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: home upkeep and knowing when to call a professional supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l03-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g12-u02-l03-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional home upkeep and knowing when to call a professional condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Hazard sorting (non-negotiable): All hazard scenarios are correctly sorted into 'stop and get adult help immediately.' | Judgment reasoning: The explanation names a specific deciding factor for each trickiest scenario..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g12-u02-l03-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
